title: Managing ZPA log receivers through the API and SDKs

prose.text: Receivers are managed through the lssConfig endpoints, with lookup endpoints for formats, status codes and client types.

prose.label: Client types path.

endpoints.statement: The API article creates a receiver with POST, reads one with GET, updates it with PUT and deletes it with DELETE, on /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/lssConfig and .../lssConfig/{lssId}, and the specification lists GET, PUT and DELETE on the item path.

quotes: Send a POST request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/lssConfig.
Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/lssConfig/{lssId}.
Send a PUT request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/lssConfig/{lssId}.
Send a DELETE request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/lssConfig/{lssId}.

expect.operationId: Gets the LSS configuration details for the specified ID.
Updates the LSS configuration for the specified ID.
Deletes the LSS configuration for the specified ID.

create-update-delete-codes.statement: A successful create returns 201, and a successful update or delete returns 204; a receiver configured through Zscaler Deception cannot be updated or deleted.

quotes: A successful response returns code 201, meaning the LSS configuration is created.
A successful response returns code 204, meaning the LSS attribute is updated.
A successful response yields code 204, meaning the LSS attribute is deleted.
If an LSS attribute is configured using Zscaler Deception, then the update option is unavailable.
If an LSS attribute is configured using Zscaler Deception, then the delete option is unavailable.

list-pagination.statement: Listing receivers supports pagination with a default page size of 20 and a maximum of 500.

quotes: This API supports pagination.
If not provided, the default page size is 20. The maximum page size is 500.

status-formats-clienttypes.statement: Lookups are GET /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/lssConfig/statusCodes for status codes, /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/lssConfig/logType/formats for log formats, and /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/lssConfig/customers/{customerId}/clientTypes for client types.

expect.operationId: Gets a list of LSS status codes.
Gets all LSS client types for the specified customer.

clienttypes-deprecated-global.statement: The specification marks the global /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/lssConfig/clientTypes endpoint as one that will be deprecated in a future release, and the customer-scoped clientTypes endpoint as the one for a specified customer.

expect.operationId: Gets all LSS client types. This API will be deprecated in a future release.
Gets all LSS client types for the specified customer.

go-clienttypes-global.statement: The Go SDK's GetClientTypes calls the global lssConfig/clientTypes path without the customer ID.

quotes: lssClientTypesEndpoint = "lssConfig/clientTypes"
relativeURL := mgmtConfigTypesAndFormats + lssClientTypesEndpoint

oas-collection-get-only.statement: The ZPA OpenAPI document gives the lssConfig collection path only a GET operation, with no POST for creating a receiver, although the API article documents POST.

expect.operationId: Gets all LSS configurations for the specified customer.

oas-collection-get-only.conditions: Absence claim: the path item in automate-zscaler/openapi/zpa.openapi.json lists the single method get. A client generated from the specification has no create call for receivers.

python-update-body.statement: The Python SDK's update_lss_config builds the PUT body from scratch with only the fields the caller supplies and does not fetch and merge the current state; config.id is always included and policyRuleResource carries the policySetId resolved from SIEM_POLICY when policy_rules is passed.

quotes: The PUT body is constructed from scratch -- this function does not
pre-fetch and merge the current state.

client-types-path.summary: Which client-types endpoint to call: the Go SDK uses the global path that the specification announces for deprecation, while the Python SDK and the API article use the customer-scoped path.

quotes: lssClientTypesEndpoint = "lssConfig/clientTypes"
self._zpa_lss_endpoint_v2 = f"/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/lssConfig/customers/{customer_id}"

client-types-path.impact: Go callers of GetClientTypes use the endpoint marked for deprecation, and the Go response type models only six client types.

groups-key.summary: What the App Connector groups key is called in a request: the article's payload template and field table say appConnectorGroups, while its sample request and responses, and both SDKs, use connectorGroups.

quotes: | appConnectorGroups | The App Connector groups to be added to the LSS configuration | No |
"connectorGroups":[ { "id":"72057594038010497", "name":"Abcdefg" }

groups-key.impact: A request that follows the template's key name instead of the sample's may not attach the groups; the SDKs send connectorGroups.
